Carlos Zapata Studio is an award-winning architecture and design firm based in SoHo, New York.
We are seeking a self-motivated Intermediate Project Architect with strong communication and coordination skills to join our team. The successful candidate will work closely with project teams and consultants on a variety of commercial, residential, and mixed-use projects.
Qualifications
Architectural license preferred.
Minimum of 5–10 years of full-time professional experience.
Experience with commercial, residential, and mixed-use projects.
Strong working knowledge of local building codes and regulatory requirements, as well as the International Building Code (IBC).
Excellent communication, coordination, and organizational skills.
Responsibilities
Produce and coordinate project documentation from concept design through construction documents.
Coordinate with consultants and project teams throughout the design process.
Contribute to the development of design presentations and technical documentation.
